question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘incarcerate’.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Liberate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incarcerate"** means to imprison or confine someone. (कैद करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The government decided to **incarcerate **the criminal for his serious offenses.
 
 
 
• **"Liberate"** refers to the action of setting someone free from imprisonment, slavery, or oppression. (मुक्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The activists worked tirelessly to **liberate **the political prisoners.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'incarcerate'** is **'liberate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Invite** (आमंत्रित करना): To make a polite, formal, or friendly request to someone to go somewhere or to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to **invite **all her friends to the party.
 
 
 
• **Reject** (अस्वीकार करना): To dismiss as inadequate, unacceptable, or faulty.
 
 
• **Example:** He was sad to learn that the committee would **reject **his application.
 
 
 
• **Commit** (प्रतिबद्ध करना): To perpetrate or carry out (a mistake, crime, or immoral act).
 
 
• **Example:** She didn't expect him to **commit **such a serious error.
